# An effect in a component built once per copy of a loop reads the props that
# copy was handed: its @mount and @update the copy's current ones, its
# @unmount the ones it had when it left.
#
# bubbletea splices the component into each copy, so a prop bound to the loop
# variable is that variable in the effect's handlers -- and passEffect runs
# them from the settle, outside the loop, so "an effect's @mount reads the
# loop variable" refused the program. The effect is keyed by the copy now,
# its handlers read the loop variables at the copy's index, and an @unmount,
# which runs once the list no longer holds the copy, reads what a recorder
# kept for it. A write to one row's key runs that row's @update alone.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var log list[string] = []

component greeter(name string) ui.node {
    effect(@mount { log.push("+" + name) }, @unmount { log.push("-" + name) })
    ui.text(value=name)
}

component counter(name string, :value int) ui.node {
    effect(on=value, @update(v) { log.push("{name}={v}") })
    ui.text(value=name)
}

struct Row {
    name string
    n    int
}

component names ui.node {
    var names = ["a", "b", "c"]

    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            greeter(name=name)
        }
    }
}

component rows ui.node {
    var rows = [Row{name="a", n=0}, Row{name="b", n=0}, Row{name="c", n=0}]

    ui.vbox {
        for var &row = rows {
            counter(name=row.name, :value=row.n)
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyMountsWithItsOwnName(t test.Test, c names) {
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "+a,+b,+c")
}

func testARemovedCopyUnmountsWithItsName(t test.Test, c names) {
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "+a,+b,+c")
    c.names = ["a", "b"]
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "+a,+b,+c,-c")
}

func testAnUpdateReadsItsCopysName(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.rows[1].n = 5
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "b=5")
}

func testAnUpdateReadsARenamedCopysNewName(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.rows[1].name = "z"
    c.rows[1].n = 7
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "z=7")
}
